```sql
WITH totals AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id,
           sum(o.total_cents)  AS revenue,
           count(*)            AS order_count,
           max(o.created_at)   AS last_order_at
      FROM orders o
     WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
       AND o.customer_id IN (SELECT c2.id
                               FROM customers c2
                              WHERE c2.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s)
     GROUP BY o.customer_id
    HAVING max(o.created_at) >= %(from)s
       AND max(o.created_at) <  %(to)s
       AND count(o.created_at) = count(*)
)
SELECT c.id,
       c.email,
       c.company,
       c.country_code,
       t.revenue,
       t.order_count,
       t.last_order_at
  FROM customers c
  JOIN totals t ON t.customer_id = c.id
 WHERE c.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
 ORDER BY t.revenue DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

Het origineel materialiseert, sorteert en aggregeert alle orders van alle tenants. Deze versie aggregeert alleen de orders van klanten van de gevraagde tenant in één pass en filtert het venster direct in `HAVING`. De omzet blijft over de hele periode berekend, en `count(created_at) = count(*)` bootst na dat `DISTINCT ON ... created_at DESC` een NULL-datum als "laatste" kiest en de klant dan uitsluit.
